sections.voiceover: Thirty million dollars laundered through an international ring landed a 35-year-old in federal prison.

Saviolli supervised the international money laundering conspiracy while operating out of Brazil. How did federal investigators track the thirty million dollars in illicit cash proceeds across borders?

sections.voiceover: The United States Department of Justice Office of Public Affairs exposed his managerial role in the scheme.

A federal judge sentenced the Brazilian national to prison for his leadership in the organization. Ygor Fokin Saviolli received 12 years behind bars. Federal prosecutors dismantled the 30 million dollar organization.
Thirty million dollars ended with 12 years inside.
